metadata.description: SarmaLinux open-source plugins for Claude Code.

plugins.name: slipstream
plugins.description: A bundled MCP server for scoped retrieval, auto-captured observation memory with semantic search and lesson distillation, lossless compaction, a cross-IDE live dashboard with a token-budget gauge, shipped subagents and a context-budget statusline that turn Claude Code (and any MCP editor) into a disciplined builder for shipping production sites.
